elements.label: Threshold: Edge, Grail and Winter
elements.description: If I wanted to deal with this threat using Edge, Grail, and Winter, I would need this much Edge, and half as much of both Grail and Winter — but perhaps there are other strategies to consider.

elements.label: Lurking
elements.description:
Breath pressed into the earth, blade hidden in the ruins.
[This enemy's next attack threshold will be increased once after concealing itself.]

elements.label: Armor Damaged
elements.description: The armor is dented, the tracks are torn, and black smoke billows from the engine—yet it remains utterly inexplicable how it still drives. [Nothing can pierce what has already been pierced.]

elements.label: Enemy Wreckage Tank
elements.description: The tank moves with a creaking wail; its rusted engine, still driven by the duty it was given in life, churns slowly but steadily forward.

elements.label: Enemy Ember Artillery
elements.description: The fractures at the muzzle are faintly visible. It laboriously raises its barrel to aim at enemies no longer where they were, unleashing its final fury.

elements.label: Enemy Ghost Fighter
elements.description: The incarnation of death ascends into the sky, thick black smoke blotting out the heavens; black snow falls over everything it passes.

elements.label: Enemy Insurgent Company
elements.description: These men were once our comrades, yet now they fight under the enemy's banner.

elements.label: Enemy Force Size

Every treeline bristles with enemy helmets, every trench is packed with their bayonets...
[When enemy force size exceeds ours, it will severely impact our morale.]

elements.description: The drone of engines fades into the distance as German aircraft vanish into the clouds trailing smoke. They will not be gone forever.
